Specifically, when encountering ';', the DFA does not transition to a state that skips until the end of the line, causing it to treat each subsequent character as separate tokens instead of recognizing the entire comment.

In the test case, after ';and "vY" (...)', the function fails to skip past the comment, leading to incorrect tokenization of 'a' and other subsequent characters as errors.
